services.name: Skydive Langar
services.desc: We're very fortunate to have an amazing community of experienced skydivers here at Langar who keep our three aircraft busy and do awesome things in the skies above the DZ. We also have a lot of fun on the ground, with some great Boogies, parties and social scene throughout the year. It's easy to get involved at Langar - just come on down! And if you'd like to get even more involved, here are a few more things to get stuck into... Your chance to win jump tickets every month! Simply submit your photo to be entered into the vote, the winning photo gets two free jump tickets added to Burble. Find out more here. Another chance to win jump tickets!
